name: eval
purpose: Evaluation dataset loading, answer extraction and regrading for `gufo eval`. The default dataset is the core fixture tests/fixtures/eval/antirez-ds4.json, so the command works in builds without DeepSeek.

compiled_elsewhere.reason: gufo_eval stays the offline dataset/extract/regrade library; the OpenAI-compatible client for `gufo eval --serve` belongs to the executable so the library keeps no socket dependency.
The test drives the raw-socket client against a local listener and links nothing else from the eval tier.
